description: This file defines a PHP class 'CountryModel' within the 'OrangeHRM' project. The class implements the 'Normalizable' interface and uses traits for serialization. It functions as a model that wraps a 'Country' entity, providing filtering and attribute naming functionalities for API serialization in the HRM system.

classes.name: CountryModel
classes.description: A model class that wraps the Country entity for serialization and API response purposes, providing filtering and attribute mapping functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Country entity and sets up filters and attribute names.
